in_marathi.name: Manvitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Wisdom, Thought
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manvitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'manas' meaning intellect or mind, and 'vith' meaning wisdom or intelligence. It is believed to be a name for a wise and thoughtful girl, one who embodies knowledge and understanding.
